description: Search Feed America's database for food pantries, food banks, soup kitchens, home-delivered meal programs, mobile pantries, SNAP application assistance, WIC offices, and FQHC health centers near a location. Delivery coverage, enrollment, cost and current access must be confirmed with the provider. Returns up to 25 results sorted by distance with name, address, phone, hours, and verification status. Covers all 50 US states + DC + Puerto Rico + US territories.

location.description: A US ZIP code (e.g. "77065") or "City, ST" (e.g. "Houston, TX"). Required.

radius_miles.description: Search radius in miles. Defaults to 10.

type.description: Filter by resource type. Options: food_pantry, food_bank, soup_kitchen, home_delivered_meals, mobile_pantry, wic_office, health_center, school_meal, summer_meal, snap_office, snap_application_assistance, state_assistance_office, emergency, community_fridge. SNAP assistance types search offices or application help, never stores. Defaults to broad food-help types, including delivered meals; excludes school and benefit offices.

name: feedam_find_food_resources
